description: baseline: published model (physics features, site z-scores, balanced HGB)
spectral band energies + waveform shape, site z-scored only (no absolute features)
shallow regularised HGB (max_depth 3, l2 1.0): fewer mode-specific interactions
drop the 13 within-window std features (keep means + derived physics)
drop the 13 window means (keep stds + derived physics)
scale deviations by plant operating level |mu|+std (percent change) instead of healthy std
z-score AND percent-change views of each feature side by side
ExtraTrees (500, balanced) instead of boosting: random thresholds, less fit to one mode's exact values
clip site z-scores to +-5: keep fault direction, drop mode-specific magnitude
logistic regression (C 0.1, balanced) on z clipped +-5: a linear model can only learn fault direction
clip z at +-3 instead of +-5
clip z at +-8 (sensitivity check around +-5)
clip z at +-10 (sensitivity check around +-5)
clip z at +-4 (sensitivity check around +-5)
add log FFT band energies (z-scored, clipped +-5): exp 1 may have failed on magnitude, not content
sqrt-of-balanced sample weights instead of class_weight=balanced
soft vote HGB + ExtraTrees on clipped z
z-score + percent-change views, both clipped +-5
add per-signal rate of change (std of first difference), z-scored and clipped: targets the PI-gain fault
loop 3 (after research): train only on fault windows that are visibly off the plant's healthy baseline (max |z| > 4); onset audit showed many fault-labelled windows look healthy
